headline: C2 splitter floods at +11%; re-tray gives +25%
summary: Existing 4-pass trays flood at 1.11× feed at polymer-grade reflux (PV1767-125-scaled-spec). With 69 wt% ethylene feed at 1.25× rate (115 000 kg/h), a high-capacity/high-efficiency re-tray in the same 16 ft shell keeps flood at 72% and lets the tower make +25% ethylene — proven run PV1767-proven-36R-28B.

cards.title: What limits today — flood, not heat

inputs.value: 156 stages (=154 trays+cond+reb), feed stage 118, P 22.94 bar, dP 1.703 bar, D 4.877 m (16 ft), spacing 0.508 m (20 in)

cards.title: Fix — high-capacity retray in existing shell (verified)

inputs.value: Reflux ratio 3.6 (down from 6.08), bottoms 280 mol/s, vent 48.5 mol/s (vs 38.8 mol/s base)

inputs.value: Max 0.614 on stage ~115 (rectifier) vs limit 0.85 → 72.2% utilised; estimated diameter for duty 5.21 m < shell + new tray uplift covers it via correlation

inputs.name: Duties at 1.25×/69wt with fix
inputs.value: Condenser ~30.7 MW, Reboiler ~21.3 MW vs base ~lower (model: heat integration not simulated, duties to confirm against refrigeration/steam headers)

inputs.name: Product purity achieved in model
inputs.value: ETHYLENE 72 505 kg/h ethylene in 78 412 kg/h total (92.5 wt% before pasteurisation trim); BOTTOMS ethylene loss 15.8 kg/h — full polymer grade (>99.95%) requires pasteurisation-section trim already lumped as liquid distillate in model

inputs.name: Real-plant reference
inputs.value: CET 69: same tower revamped 2015 with high-capacity trays exceeded +25% capacity and efficiency vs 4-pass conventional
inputs.source: CET 69 (2018) Fig 2 — withheld details, consistent with capacity factor +27%

assumptions: 69 wt% ethylene feed mapped to 69.6 mol% ethylene (x=0.696) with Ethane 0.30044, N2 0.00044, Methane 0.00084, Propylene 0.0014, Isobutane 0.00068 — to match request ~69 wt% (model mass balance gives 68.1 wt% ethylene, close).

Pasteurisation chimney / pasteurization section performance lumped into liquid distillate ETHYLENE as per model_mapping note — model reports total liquid ethylene to pasteurisation, real plant finishes to polymer grade in chimney trays.

DWSIM PR EOS + Fair flooding screen with vendor tray_capacity_factor 1.3 (existing 4-pass) and 1.65 (high-capacity) used as stand-in for vendor hydraulic correlation; side reboiler duties folded into main reboiler duty.
Condenser/reboiler duties from DWSIM are process duties only; highly heat-integrated refrigeration and steam system limits not in model — to be checked.
No fouling/foaming correlation change assumed; existing efficiency 0.78 → 0.85 with new trays per vendor high-efficiency claim.

field_checks.item: Actual flood margin on rectifying stages 2-20
field_checks.where: Differential pressure per tray section and gamma scans on PV-1767 at current max rate — compare to DWSIM flood 0.702 base prediction
field_checks.changes: If measured flood occurs earlier (foaming, damage) the 1.11× limit drops; if later, a smaller capacity-factor uplift (1.45) may suffice

field_checks.item: Polymer-grade purity vs ethane slip at 1.25×/69wt
field_checks.where: Online GC on ETHYLENE distillate and BOTTOMS ethylene loss at stable 3.6 reflux, 280 mol/s bottoms
field_checks.changes: If ethane in overhead >0.1 wt%, reflux must rise to ~3.8-4.0 — still under 85% flood but condenser duty +2 MW, verify refrigeration

field_checks.item: Condenser (~30.7 MW) and reboiler (~21.3 MW) system limits
field_checks.where: Check chilled refrigeration header and C2 splitter reboiler steam/hot process integration at 115 000 kg/h feed
field_checks.changes: If refrigeration cap <31 MW, max scale limited to ~1.20× even with trays — needs refrigeration debottleneck, not trays

field_checks.item: Vendor tray hydraulic/efficiency guarantee in 4.877 m shell at 0.508 m spacing
field_checks.where: Vendor pilot flood test curves for proposed HiFi/UFM Plus-type high-capacity 4-pass replacement
field_checks.changes: Capacity factor 1.65 assumed; if vendor only guarantees 1.50, 1.25× flood becomes 0.67 → still <0.85 but margin shrinks from 28% to 21%

highlights.text: Limits at +11% today (flood 100% at 1.11×); high-capacity retray to 1.65/0.85 keeps flood 72% at 1.25×/69wt — verified PV1767-proven-36R-28B

proposals.title: Re-tray PV-1767 with high-capacity/high-efficiency trays for +25% ethylene

changes.basis: Replace 154 × 4-pass conventional trays in existing 4.877 m ID × 0.508 m spacing shell with high-capacity trays (Shell HiFi Plus / Sulzer UFM Plus class) — vendor correlation +27% flood capacity vs existing 1.3 factor, +7 pts efficiency (CET 69 real revamp achieved this)

proposals.why: Cheapest fix that holds at every condition: same shell, same spacing, only internals. Operating moves alone cannot pass 1.11× flood; richer feed lowers reflux to 3.6 but flood still exceeds 100% with old trays. High-capacity factor 1.65 drops 1.25× flood to 61% enabling 25% more polymer-grade ethylene; margin left for summer condenser limits.

proposals.title: Confirm refrigeration and reboiler headers support 30.7/21.3 MW at 1.25× (no new exchanger in model)
proposals.why: DWSIM duties at 1.25×/69wt are ~30.7 MW condenser and ~21.3 MW reboiler vs base case lower; plant heat-integrated system must be checked — if short, rate limited to ~1.20× until refrigeration debottleneck. No equipment change proposed in DWSIM until vendor duty confirm.

request: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene from this tower at polymer-grade purity. What limits the C2 splitter, and what is the change?
